the decision algorithm performance is strongly related to the frequency of usage of conditional attributes, and the frequency of their usage can be exploited to construct decision algorithms with better performance than those obtained by selection of rules with support threshold.

decision algorithms resulting from DRSA analysis of stylometric features of literary texts should not be limited to rules with most frequent attributes, but also include rules with least frequent attributes.
